concerns.quote: police forces have established ABD protocols with their local ambulance service so that suspected ABD incidents are treated as medical emergencies (i.e. Cat 1, with a response time of 8 minutes)
concerns.hazard: lack of established police ambulance protocols

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that the NHS Pathways system does not adequately recognise or prioritise excited delirium/acute behavioural disturbance, leading to inappropriate ambulance responses.
links.earlier_quote: The version of NHS Pathways currently in use is version 16 which does not enable operators to recognise potential ED / ABD and respond accordingly.
links.later_quote: Under the current NHS Pathways system, ABD does not have its own allocation pathway.
